name: Random Game Picker
summary: Pick an existing ES game with saved filters and scraped art.

notes: Stable 0.2.0 replaces the C++ implementation with Go and gabagool while keeping the launcher, install paths and settings schema. A plays, X rerolls, Y opens settings and Y inside settings rescans. Development-build TSP injection and handoff evidence does not verify physical presses, audible sound or normal gameplay/hotkey return; no MagicX hardware result is claimed. Store review status remains experimental.

The version-specific URL, exact size and SHA-256 pin the reviewed bytes. GitHub reports immutable=false: this is not a server-enforced immutable release. The Store rejects replacement bytes; release.immutable declares the pinned-content contract, not a GitHub repository setting.

The picker reads effective ES system configuration, gamelists and the live ES catalogue; no game ROM directory or emulator command is hardcoded. Ports, collections, missing/hidden games and ambiguous launch paths are excluded.

The only network use is bounded HTTP to 127.0.0.1:1234. Play closes SDL, sends one exact raw-path POST to ES and exits. HTTP acceptance does not confirm play; there is no retry or nested configgen fallback.

The Store owns only its package directory and one Ports menu entry. Preserve the entire state directory: settings.json, atomic settings.json.tmp, replaced-per-run last-run.log and new ui.log. The system string and favorites boolean are unchanged; no schema migration is needed. A nonstandard configured Ports root needs manual installation in that root instead.

Includes the TSP-tested A/B and X/Y correction: default KNULLI SDL bindings translate back to ES labels. The launcher honors the Ports Xbox-layout flag, which keeps the identity mapping. Both launcher and binary must update together; this report does not verify every external controller or MagicX.

Published AArch64 ELF inspection establishes a glibc 2.34 minimum. Firmware SDL2, SDL2_image, SDL2_ttf and SDL2_gfx are required; no firmware library is bundled or replaced. Go/module/font license notices replace the old C++ runtime notices; no libstdc++ runtime dependency remains.

evidence.note: Downloaded stable ZIP: 3,273,845 compressed bytes, 7,872,532 regular-file bytes across 20 files; SHA-256 3f8a225cffcb2a89ffee166ff4f06dbf87923142309d97203e738a8200737df4. Publisher artifact.json and SHA256SUMS.txt agree. Flat layout; no archive links. GitHub does not enforce immutability for this release.

MIT project license. ZIP includes THIRD_PARTY.md, Go toolchain and module LICENSE/COPYING files, and the DejaVu font notice. SDL libraries remain firmware dependencies. Historical C++ notices in THIRD_PARTY.md describe 0.1.1, not the Go executable.

ELF64 AArch64, interpreter /lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1; highest GLIBC symbol 2.34. NEEDED: libSDL2_image-2.0.so.0, libSDL2-2.0.so.0, libSDL2_ttf-2.0.so.0, libSDL2_gfx-1.0.so.0 and libc.so.6. No libstdc++ runtime dependency.

Launcher sets package-local state and reads /var/run/ports_xbox_layout.flag without writing it. Settings/atomic temporary file, last-run.log and ui.log stay under state. ES config, ROMs, art and saves are read-only to the picker; the launched emulator can make its normal writes. Only bounded loopback ES requests are used.

Passed stable release workflow publishes the ARM64 ZIP, artifact.json, SHA256SUMS.txt, abi.txt and archive-inventory.txt. Release bytes and metadata were independently downloaded and checked; this workflow is not physical-device evidence.

Go development-build TSP evidence: firmware gfx/startup, 161-game selection, 100 injected rerolls, default/Xbox effective mappings, exact-path Gambatte handoff and ES restoration. RA login errors prevent normal gameplay/hotkey-return proof. Physical presses and audible audio remain unverified. This does not grant stable 0.2.0 or MagicX a verified badge.

install.warning: Experimental Go 0.2.0: no complete stable-version hardware verification. Requires glibc 2.34+, firmware SDL2/image/ttf/gfx and local ES API. Submit Play once; inspect state/last-run.log and state/ui.log before retrying. Standard Ports location only. Settings/logs stay after uninstall.
